died.name: Berengar of Tours
died.cause: dying in ascetic solitude on the island of Saint-Cosme near Tours
died.last_words: I shall not long hesitate between conscience and the Pope, for I shall soon appear in the presence of God, to be acquitted, I hope; to be condemned, I fear.

died.name: Philip Danforth Armour

died.last_words: I am not afraid to die.
